activities.name: begin_load
activities.description: Registers the run in covid_etl.load_audit and clears this run's staging rows.

activities.name: copy_cases_and_deaths
activities.description: Copies the processed snapshot into run-scoped staging (covid_staging.cases_and_deaths). Production is never written here.

activities.name: validate_staged_snapshot
activities.description: Rejects empty, partial, NULL-key or duplicate-key snapshots before publication.

activities.name: publish_snapshot
activities.description: Replaces covid_reporting.cases_and_deaths with the validated snapshot in one transaction under an exclusive app lock. Idempotent on retry.

activities.name: record_load_failure
activities.description: Runs when any step fails: marks the audit row Failed and clears this run's staging rows. Production is untouched.

value.value: @concat('ADF activity failure in pipeline ', pipeline().Pipeline, '; see ADF Monitor for run ', pipeline().RunId)

message.value: @concat('Load of covid_reporting.cases_and_deaths failed; the previous production snapshot was kept. Pipeline run ', pipeline().RunId, '. See covid_etl.load_audit.')
